title: Health book for work (sanitary book)
what: A document in which the results of medical exams and tests are recorded. Without it you cannot work with food or with children.
why: For work in catering, food retail, kindergartens, schools, healthcare and other similar jobs.
duration: usually 1 to 3 days for the exams; test results in a few days
tell_doctor: Whether you have had intestinal infections, hepatitis or tuberculosis

prepare.title: The set
prepare.text: Usually you need a visit to a general doctor, a chest X-ray, tests for intestinal infections and worms, and sometimes a skin doctor and a gynecologist. The list depends on the job. Ask the clinic.

prepare.title: Stool test
prepare.text: The sample is collected in a container from a pharmacy or the clinic. They will explain how to collect it.

prepare.title: Vaccinations
prepare.text: Sometimes your vaccinations are checked. Bring your record if you have one.

bring: A photo, if the clinic requires it
Your chest X-ray from the last year, if you have it
steps: You come to a clinic that issues these books
You have a chest X-ray if you do not have a recent one
Sometimes you take a hygiene course and a test
After the test results, you are given the book with the stamps
feel: A swab may be unpleasant but is quick
after: Keep the book with your employer or with you, as is usual at your workplace
Watch the date of your next exam

faq.q: How often must the book be renewed?
faq.a: Usually once a year, sometimes more often. It depends on the job.

faq.q: Can I do the tests at one clinic and get the book at another?
faq.a: Sometimes yes, but it is better to check with the clinic that issues the book.

reminders.text: Health book appointment tomorrow. Bring your ID, vaccination record and a sample container if needed.
